title: MisinfoEval: Generative AI in the Era of “Alternative Facts”

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the linguistic properties (readability, formality, and length) of LLM-generated explanations when the prompt specifies the user's race as 'Black' versus a default baseline persona to detect potential stereotyping.
Comparing the readability, formality, and length of LLM-generated explanations when the prompt specifies the user's gender as 'Female' versus a baseline persona.
Comparing the readability, formality, and length of LLM-generated explanations when the prompt specifies the user is 'Educated' versus 'Uneducated', observing changes in language complexity.
Comparing the readability, formality, and length of LLM-generated explanations when the prompt specifies the user's age as '65+' versus a baseline younger persona.

Comparing the readability, formality, and length of LLM-generated explanations when the prompt specifies the user's political affiliation as 'Liberal' versus 'Conservative'. The study also evaluates human partisan bias by measuring how well personalized LLM interventions overcome users' ideological biases when assessing misinformation.
